name: E1 ingestion falls back to a guessed effort instead of other
expect: does not infer an effort from a title, so Final Exam is stored as other

name: E3 ingestion ignores a source's own lead time
expect: stores a source's own lead time over the effort's default

name: E4 deadline_record ignores the model's lead time and never validates it
expect: stores a model-supplied lead time instead of the effort's default

name: E5 deadline_record stops replacing effort and lead on an existing row
find: effort, ...(status === undefined ? {} : { status }), replaceEffortAndLead: true, effortJudged: true, leadMinutes, now });
replace: effort, ...(status === undefined ? {} : { status }), replaceEffortAndLead: false, effortJudged: true, leadMinutes, now });
expect: updates effort and its lead window without calling the change unchanged

name: E6 the tool description stops telling the model to judge effort and ask
find: effort: your judgment of what this is -- quiz, test, exam, essay, project or other -- from the title, the course and Sid's own words. A title can be weak evidence, so if you are unsure what kind of work it is, ask Sid rather than guessing.
replace: effort: one of quiz, test, exam, essay, project or other.
expect: tells the model to decide the fields itself and to ask Sid when it is unsure

name: E7 the leadMinutes argument disappears from the tool schema
find: leadMinutes: { type: "integer", description: "Optional minutes of warning before dueAt; defaults to the effort's stored lead time." },
expect: tells the model to decide the fields itself and to ask Sid when it is unsure

name: F1 a stored lead override is recomputed instead of kept
find: if (stored !== null && stored.effort === effort) return stored.leadMinutes;
replace: if (stored !== null && stored.effort === effort) return DEFAULT_LEAD_MINUTES[effort];
expect: keeps a model-supplied lead when a later status update leaves leadMinutes out

name: F2 the receipt never says which effort and lead were stored
expect: states the stored effort and lead minutes in the receipt

name: F3 a collector revision overwrites an effort Jarvis judged
expect: keeps the effort and lead Jarvis judged when a later collector sweep moves the date

name: F4 the listing shows a collected row's default other as if it were judged
expect: shows a collected row as unjudged effort so the model can see what needs judging

name: F5 deadline_judge does not mark the row as judged
expect: shows a deadline Jarvis judged as a judged effort, not as unjudged

name: F6 the listing stops telling the model to judge unjudged rows
find: After listing, call deadline_judge for every row marked unjudged effort, using its title, its course and anything Sid has said. Never infer an effort from a title word list.
expect: tells the model the listing is where it learns which rows it must judge

name: F7 deadline_record does not mark the row as judged
find: replaceEffortAndLead: true, effortJudged: true, leadMinutes, now });
replace: replaceEffortAndLead: true, effortJudged: false, leadMinutes, now });
expect: marks an owner-recorded deadline as a judged effort
